product_one_liner.value: Jack & Jill pairs Jack, a career agent that helps candidates find and prepare for jobs, with Jill, an AI hiring agent that sources candidates and facilitates introductions for companies.

employee_band.notes: The company says it has 28 people.

founded_year.notes: The investor says the founders started Jack & Jill in March 2025 and Companies House records incorporation in 2025; the company llms.txt instead lists 2024, so the sources differ on the founding date.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows hiring, product, company, and press content rather than two engineering posts on how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public docs index links to multiple product guides and integration articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The nine listed openings include a Founding Engineer, but none has AI, ML, or data science in its title.

model_provider.notes: The public terms, FAQ, docs, privacy policy, and blog refer to AI or large language models but do not identify the provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy refers to rights under UK GDPR; it does not claim a formal GDPR certification, and I found no claim of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS.

raised_18mo.notes: The $40M Series A was announced on 15 September 2026, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company lists live Account Executive openings in San Francisco and London.

launched_6mo.notes: Company Insights was announced as launching on 4 November 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small team page lists the co-founder CEO and CTO and no VP; the CFO is shown as an open role. I found no announced C-level or VP departure.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public integration docs name ATS platforms and Slack, but do not identify a CRM or sales/marketing stack used by the company.
